Sandbox_InventoryTetris_EnforceCarryWeig: If enabled, container weight limits are strictly enforced. (Defaults to true automatically in Multiplayer for server authority).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_EncumbranceSlow_: Slows character movement speed when heavily overencumbered.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_PreventTardisSta: Prevents placing containers inside other containers of equal or greater size.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_UseItemTransferT: Uses calculated timed actions for transferring items. (Singleplayer Only. Disabled in MP due to server limits).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_ItemTransferSpee: Multiplier for how fast items transfer between containers. (Singleplayer Only. Disabled in MP due to server limits).
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_BonusGridSize_to: Adds extra grid width and height to ALL inventory containers globally.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_EnablePlayerInve: Adds a 4x3 general-purpose grid to the character's main inventory, large enough for common 2x2 crafting and cooking items. Clothing pockets remain separate. The Dev Tool can override the player grid size.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_StackSizeMultipl: Multiplies Inventory Tetris stack limits globally. Enter a value from 0.01 to 100.0. Default is 1.0. Items that do not stack remain non-stackable.
Sandbox_InventoryTetris_ItemWeightMultip: Scales actual Java item weights (e.g. 0.10 = 10 percent weight). Set to 1.0 to disable. Grid footprints remain fixed at original script sizes.
